 The Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) is alerting consumers about new food recalls for products sold through major Canadian stores and marketplaces, including those sold at Costco, Walmart, Amazon and Whole Foods.
 One Degree Organic Foods Sprouted Whole Wheat Flour 
 Issue Allergen — gluten
 Where sold Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Quebec, Saskatchewan. Products were sold through Whole Foods Market and Amazon.
 What to do Do not use, sell, serve or distribute the affected product.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 News 
 Flour sold in Canada through Amazon and Whole Foods Market recalled due to misleading claim 
 Metroland Staff 
 Movie Night Gift Set — Lamontagne Milk Chocolate Bar (100 g) 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Issue Undeclared almonds
 Where sold Costco warehouse or online at Costco.ca between Sept. 24, 2026 and Oct. 16, 2026.
 What to do Return to a Costco warehouse to get a full refund

 Issue Undeclared peanut
 What to do Don’t eat products that could contain ingredients you’re allergic or sensitive to

 How to report an issue with a consumer product, drug, cannabis or food
 You can report a food concern or complaint to the CFIA .
 Consumers can report any health or safety incidents related to the use of products by filling out a consumer product incident report form .
 To report a health or safety complaint with a cannabis product, fill out the cannabis reporting form online.
 Report any drug or health product side effects or complaints to Health Canada.
 You can check for more recall notices published by Health Canada and CFIA online.
